title: Analysis code and supporting data for "Compliance Mismatch Drives Mechanochemical Reactivity in Diels-Alder Reactions"
description: Figure-analysis notebook and supporting data for Compliance Mismatch Drives Mechanochemical Reactivity in Diels-Alder Reactions. The analysis compares force-induced reaction-barrier changes, molecular compliance, deformation, and hydrostatic-pressure response in cyclopentadiene-based Diels-Alder reactions. Large numerical archives and gamma-scan JSON files are distributed separately through Zenodo; see README.md and DATA_MANIFEST.csv for file locations and checksums.
